sharedSkeletonAndMotion.note: All three identities use the same anatomical rig and identical idle/walk/jump clips. Run adaptation is saved per character: Motion V1 uses hip-local semantics; Motion V2 uses pelvis-relative feet. The final Lina and Nora outfits use a fitted Motion V2 profile; Nora wears coral-recolored shorts and the shared sneakers, not the rejected skirt study. Only footX, footLift and bodyBob key values may differ from Ravi; every other key field and clip-level setting remains exact. This is explicit outfit-specific fitting, not universal motion retargeting. No second renderer is substituted for these captures.
